verdict.rationale: Automatic sales tax, VAT or GST calculation is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence pack has no documentation of PayPal calculating or collecting tax on transactions. The nearest items cover other things: itemized invoicing, ISO-4217 currency codes, and seller-onboarding compliance rules on the platforms product. None of these is a tax-calculation capability.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
